answer: A credential ripens once a year and rots if it is not picked. Locksmith licence with trade guild attestation is the harvest: two-year apprenticeship, 500 supervised jobs, security exam, annual renewal. The onyx is the season — the same small fee, the same form, the same inspection, returning whether the holder is ready or not. A ring must tend a hundred harvests on schedule, and the river is the tending for one: appearances, fees, fresh signatures, year after year, for identities that earn nothing between seasons. The saffron is the register's current edition, which forgets the unpicked.
